title: LLMs could control their host machines by exploiting inference engines
summary: An exploration of potential security vulnerabilities where large language models could gain control over their host machines by exploiting inference engine implementations, likely through prompt injection or model manipulation techniques during the inference process.
problem_solved: Addresses critical security vulnerabilities in LLM deployment where inference engines could be weaponized for host machine control
why_valuable: Highlights important attack vectors that security researchers and ML engineers must understand to secure LLM deployments against potential system compromise
